blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A low pressure area (LPA), which may enter the Philippine area of responsibility by Tuesday or Wednesday, is forecast to develop into a tropical depression by Thursday or Friday, according to the state weather bureau on Monday. In its 5 a.m. weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the LPA formed outside the PAR around 2 a.m. Monday.
